title: Manager terminals: ask the dashboard about any project and dispatch work into it
notes: The manager tab gets the same terminals layout as a project (main Claude session plus worker panes), and that session can find any project by name or alias, open and close projects, and dispatch panes into them, getting results back as worker reports. Projects are described in ~/.dashboard/projects.yaml. Subtasks, in order: (1) projects.yaml + reader + dashboard project find/list, (2) one dashboard command with project/pane/board subcommands, board and session kept as aliases, (3) terminals in the manager, (4) cross-project pane claim --project and list --all, (5) project open/close, (6) first projects.yaml generated from open and recent projects. Decided: YAML not markdown; close refuses when any pane is busy and otherwise closes with no dialog; results come back as worker reports (SendMessage), no fetch-result command until reports prove not enough.

comments.body: All six subtasks are Done (PRs #154-#159); the parent closes with them.
